title: Evaluating Evaluation Metrics: A Framework for Analyzing NLG Evaluation Metrics using Measurement Theory

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Natural Language Generation (NLG) metrics using Multitrait-Multimethod (MTMM) matrices and factor analysis to detect if scores depend primarily on rater subjectivity or shared measurement artifacts (lack of divergent validity) rather than the actual model performance on the rated dimensions.

Applying measurement theory to quantify systematic and random measurement errors in evaluation metrics, assessing construct validity and reliability to identify if an evaluation rubric or metric systematically deviates from true unobservable model capabilities.
